name: Heart Drops
dosage:
According to the weakness of the heart, 3 times daily 10-20-30 drops in some water, in the beginning even 4-6 times daily
In case of a strong tendency towards hydropsy, to be taken undiluted
Improvement should follow after several days only
If not, the dose should be increased, and reduced again after improvement to 20 drops, 3 times a day
Even after the complete disappearance of the complaints 10
side_effects: No known side effects when taken as directed.
